decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: East slot 1, Central slot 2, North slot 3, West slot 4, South slot 5, Int'l slot 6
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, none moved
point markers on every value of East: black-and-white reproduction is likely: the symbol square at every point
point markers on every value of Central: black-and-white reproduction is likely: the symbol triangle at every point
point markers on every value of North: black-and-white reproduction is likely: the symbol × at every point
point markers on every value of West: black-and-white reproduction is likely: the symbol filled circle at every point
point markers on every value of South: black-and-white reproduction is likely: the symbol + at every point
point markers on every value of Int'l: black-and-white reproduction is likely: the symbol asterisk at every point
the unit phrase on the top label: “120 employees”; the top gridline starts after it
time axis: row 2 (“2019”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
6 lines, crossing 0 times, labelled directly: they rarely cross (G1.20, D-28)

findings.message: the unit phrase “employees” is one word; say what is counted, which subset and per what period
findings.title: a unit phrase specific enough for one reading

source.shows: a chart likely to be copied in black and white: each line keeps its colour and gets its own marker symbol at every point, square, triangle, ×, filled circle, + and asterisk in the order of the line ends (G7.14, D-33), the symbols told apart where the colours would not be; never a dash pattern (G7.10)
